events.description: The camera wearer walks through a snowy parking area past parked vehicles while approaching companions carrying sleds.
The group carries colorful sleds along an icy paved path from the parking area toward the snow hill.
They enter the wooded sledding area and continue along the snowy path toward the top of the hill.
The camera wearer and companions mill around the crowded staging area, looking at the hill and other sledders among the trees.
The group moves to the crest and surveys the broad sledding slope and mountain scenery below.
The companion in a blue jacket gets onto a sled near the crest and slides downhill lying forward.
Companions regroup near the launch area while people walk back uphill and sledders continue descending around them.
The blue-jacketed companion sits on a round blue saucer and takes another ride down the slope.
The beige-jacketed companion sits on a patterned sled and begins sliding downhill.
The group waits and prepares near the crest as families arrange sleds and riders pass on the hill.
The camera wearer sits on a sled at the crest while the blue-jacketed companion approaches and gestures nearby.
The camera wearer makes a first-person sled descent, with their knees visible as the snowy slope moves past.
After stopping, the camera wearer heads back uphill toward the crowded crest.
The camera wearer rests and prepares another sled at the tree-lined top of the hill with companions nearby.
The camera wearer completes a second first-person sled ride down the hill, passing other riders on the slope.
The camera wearer and companions walk uphill carrying their sleds after the ride.
While the group climbs, the blue-jacketed companion briefly slides downhill past on a round sled.
The uphill walk resumes and the group reaches the crest among waiting sledders and pine trees.
At the top, the camera wearer looks down the busy slope and gets seated for another run.
The camera wearer takes a long first-person sled ride across the slope, sometimes rotating to face uphill and weaving among walkers and seated riders.
During the ride, the camera wearer passes close to the blue-jacketed companion seated on a sled.
The moving camera approaches two people lying or sitting directly ahead, and gloved hands rise as the sled passes the obstacle.
The ride slows or stops, and the camera wearer looks back uphill at scattered sledders continuing their runs.

warnings: Events near the end are estimated from uniformly sampled frames; brief stops or additional ride transitions may occur between samples.
